Assess our UK online free-shipping threshold.
Currently, UK delivery costs £8 below £250 and is free at £250 or above. Use this year’s evidence through the latest completed day.
Order values
Show UK online GBP orders in £25 bands from £100 to £350, with wider bands outside that range. Include order counts and percentages where the full eligible population is available.
Use the merchandise value that actually determines shipping eligibility. Establish whether this is after discounts and includes VAT; keep shipping charges separate. Exclude non-UK and POS orders.
Threshold scenarios
Compare the current £250 threshold with £175, £200, £225, £275 and £300.
For each, show:
\- Orders that would newly qualify for free shipping or lose eligibility.
\- Estimated shipping revenue forgone or gained on those existing orders, assuming purchasing behavior stays unchanged.
\- Actual recorded shipping charges where available. Separate an illustrative £8-per-order calculation from observed charges.
Do not assume every order below £250 paid £8: check free-shipping discounts, exceptions and missing evidence.
Add-on opportunity
Focus on orders £10–£75 below £250. Show how much customers would need to add to qualify.
Identify current published products at suitable UK prices that could bridge those gaps. Use existing product and basket evidence to suggest relevant add-ons; do not retrieve inventory or invent product relationships.
Highlight where the additional spend needed exceeds the £8 delivery saving. Do not assume customers will add an item just to receive free shipping.
Recommendation
Explain what the evidence supports about keeping or testing a different threshold. Show the May sale separately where confirmed dates support it.
Keep shipping-fee revenue distinct from carrier costs and profit. If product margins and actual fulfilment costs are unavailable, state that a profit-optimal threshold cannot yet be calculated.
Lead with a short recommendation and compact scenario table. Put definitions, coverage and supporting evidence in Show details. No collection, backfill or mutation.
